prototypeScope: V1.19 delta package: the rear converter box cap and the battery backpack cap with 3.0 mm screw-head floors on one Orange plate (Shawn 2026-10-15, IMG_7004: the V1.17 cap floors tore). Both frames stay as printed in V1.17 / V1.18.
knownFitBoundary: Shells need the V1.9 rear pack (its shoulder bars); Shawn confirmed it is fitted. The pack bar has no printed pilot: drill dia 1.6 through the shell roof hole with a tape flag 7.0 mm from the tip. Driver above each pack screw on the finished robot: 57.8 mm to the lower head shell. Cap: closes with the same three ROBOTIS M2.6 x 6 as the V1.9 cap; the A7Z rests on the four round pads and screws on with the Pi screws (E-pi-01..04). Face: the camera takes 4 x M2 x 4 into 2.4 mm of thread (below the 3.5 mm target, face-a7z/README.md) and the eye trim 2 x M2 x 6 from the face back; the image needs a 90 deg rotation in software. Thighs: same geometry as the 10/1 thighs; fitting them means taking both legs apart and re-reading the joint zeros (guide/firmware/mac/pose_snapshot.py). Battery backpack: built for the Tattu 2S 650 listing size (57 x 31 x 12 mm) in a 58 x 32 x 13 pocket; measure the pack before printing if it may be larger. It mounts on the same four cover screws as the rear converter box (swap one for the other); cap 3 x M2 x 8, fixing 4 x M2 x 6. V1.19 caps: the box cap takes the same four M2 x 10 as V1.17 and fits the printed V1.17 frame; tighten until the cap sits on the rim and stop, the heads bear on printed floors.
processOverrideReason: No process overrides: V1.19 carries only the Orange plate.

parts.changeReason: V1.19: the V1.17 layout F cap with each of its four screw-head floors thickened from 1.0 to 3.0 mm. The printed V1.17 cap's two low floors tore into open holes when it was taken off (Shawn 2026-10-15, IMG_7004). The floors grow 2.0 mm forward (column fronts x -53.1 low, -52.6 top), so the head seats (x -56.1 / -55.6), the four stock M2 x 10 and the thread engagement (3.9 / 4.6 mm) are unchanged; the +y low column is flattened to 0.5 mm above the USB-C socket. Gaps: 1.5 mm to the 5991 PCB, 1.25 mm to the 7 V board, cap to boards 0.287 mm (unchanged walls). Evidence: back-plate/layout-F/raycast_cap_screws.json and post_build.json.
